import bpy
exec("from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
OUT=ROOT/'assets/reference'
changed=0
for v in terrain.data.vertices:
 p=terrain.matrix_world@v.co;x=p.x;z=-p.y
 basin=(1-smooth(2.25,2.7,abs(z-65.2)))*smooth(1.0,2.5,x)*(1-smooth(16.55,17.1,x))
 new=min(p.z,p.z+(-1.90-p.z)*basin)
 if abs(new-p.z)>1e-6:v.co.z=new;changed+=1
terrain.data.update();bpy.context.view_layer.update()
bv=BVHTree.FromObject(terrain,bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get());rows=[]
for name in ['R20_UpperHull','R20_LowerHull','R20_HullBottom']:
 ob=bpy.data.objects[name]
 for poly in ob.data.polygons:
  pts=[ob.data.vertices[i].co for i in poly.vertices]
  for pp in pts+[sum(pts,Vector())/len(pts)]:
   p=ob.matrix_world@pp
   if p.z>.6:continue
   hit,n,idx,dist=bv.ray_cast(Vector((p.x,p.y,25)),Vector((0,0,-1)),60)
   if hit:rows.append({'point':list(p),'gap':p.z-hit.z})
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r['gap'])
report={'samples':len(rows),'minimum':rows[0],'intersections':sum(r['gap']<0 for r in rows),'changed_vertices':changed}
(LOG/'cargo_clearance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8');print(report)
assert report['minimum']['gap']>.25
export_collection('Reference_Terrain','terrain.glb')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
",bpy.app.driver_namespace['resume20'])
